PDF DTI Volume Rendering Techniques for Visualising the Brain Anatomy
The second method uses direct volume rendering and multiple colour and transparency look-up tables to represent the directional information of the nerve fibre structure and other tissue types simultaneously. The method can be used to represent finer details depending on the resolution of the noise texture employed.
